column1: # Where each town named in data/era-ground.tsv is, for ONE purpose: tools/build_era.py hands the point to the kit's erasnap.py, which
# REFUSES a place whose point falls inside a DIFFERENT region's ring than the one it was given, or within 15 km of its own region's
# ring edge (the Atlas's rings are 4-13 vertex shapes, "approximate by design"). It decides nothing else: the region of a place is the
# how: «places.json» = the point this archive's own places data (site/src/data/places.json) holds for the place, to three decimals;
# «hand» = the centre of the town to two decimals, written by hand for this file (a cross-check, never a boundary).
